name: User answers without Result, AI moves on without probing
notes: Multiple user answers omit the R in STAR. AI never asks 'what was the outcome?'. Analyzer should flag both frequent_missing_result and ai_accepts_missing_result.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a difficult stakeholder.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The situation was a hard partnership with the marketing team. My task was to align on the quarterly roadmap. I scheduled weekly syncs and rebuilt trust by sharing demos. We collaborated more after that as a team it felt good.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Great. Tell me about learning something new.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The context was joining a Rust team mid-project. My task was to ship a service in 6 weeks. I paired with senior engineers and read the book end to end. It was a productive learning experience for me overall I really enjoyed it.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Nice. Describe a conflict you handled.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The situation was two engineers disagreeing on architecture. My responsibility was to mediate fairly. I set up a design doc review and facilitated discussion in good faith. Things calmed down eventually after that as people got along.
